title: Planting characteristics of grasses and legumes & Sowing rate
text:
Planting characteristics of grasses:

Forage | Distance between Furrows | Distance bet. Plant | Planting Material
Napier | 70 cm | 40 cm | Stem cutting
Paragrass | 40 cm | 40 cm | Root stock/ stem cutting
Signal Grass | 50 cm | 40 cm | Root Stocks/Seeds
Guinea Grass | 50 cm | 40 cm | Root Stock/Seeds

Planting characteristics of legumes:

Forage | Distance between Furrows | Distance between Plant | Planting Material
Kudzu | Broadcast seeds | Seeds
Centrosema | Broadcast seeds | Seeds
Flemingia | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Seeds
Indigofera | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Seeds
Desmodium | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Seeds
Calliandra | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Seedlings
Ipil-Ipil | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Seedlings
Madre Cacao | 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) | Sticks/ Posts

facts: Napier grass requires 70 cm distance between furrows, 40 cm distance between plants, and uses stem cutting as planting material.
Paragrass requires 40 cm distance between furrows, 40 cm distance between plants, and uses root stock or stem cutting as planting material.
Signal grass requires 50 cm distance between furrows, 40 cm distance between plants, and uses root stocks or seeds as planting material.
Guinea grass requires 50 cm distance between furrows, 40 cm distance between plants, and uses root stock or seeds as planting material.
All four listed grasses (Napier, Paragrass, Signal Grass, Guinea Grass) share the same distance between plants of 40 cm.
Kudzu and Centrosema legumes are sown by broadcasting seeds.
Flemingia, Indigofera, and Desmodium legumes are planted in hedge rows at 50 cm x 30 cm using seeds.
Calliandra is planted at 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) using seedlings.
Ipil-Ipil is planted at 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) using seedlings.
Madre Cacao is planted at 50 cm x 30 cm (hedge row) using sticks or posts as planting material.
A visual comparison illustrates the seedling density differences between a 'Good sowing rate' and a 'Very high sowing rate'.
